author.description: An unverified author, creator or artist name embedded in the source file.

binary-tag-count.description: Number of binary metadata placeholders skipped by the extractor.

detected-format.description: File format detected by the parser.

device-owner.description: An unverified device owner name embedded in the source file.

document-id.description: An unverified document or original-document identifier embedded in the source file.

extraction-profile.description: Parser option profile for the extraction.

last-modified-by.description: An unverified name recorded as the last editor in the source file.

lens-serial-number.description: An unverified lens serial number embedded in the source file.

location-claim.description: Unverified embedded location claim with the source tag name and raw value.

metadata-tag.description: JSON record containing the source tag name and its raw parser value.

omitted-tag-count.description: Number of extracted tags omitted due to result limits.

parser.description: Name of the parser used to extract the metadata.

serial-number.description: An unverified camera or device serial number embedded in the source file.

software.description: An embedded name or version of software reported to have created, processed or encoded the source file.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source bytes processed by the parser.

timestamp-claim.description: Unverified embedded time or date claim with the source tag name, raw value, precision and timezone status.

warning.description: A parser diagnostic or extraction limitation.

description: Metadata extracted from a source file with parser provenance, correlation fields and unverified embedded claims.
name: file-metadata
